summary: 봄과 가을 이동기에 서해의 섬에 드물게 찾아오는 솔새로, 2007년 5월 소청도에서 처음 기록된 뒤 소청도·백령도·연평도 등에서 거의 해마다 몇 차례씩 기록된다. 덤불의 낮은 곳에서 곤충을 찾으며, 긴다리솔새사촌과 생김새가 매우 비슷해 금속성의 짧은 울음소리로 가려낸다. 중국 북동부에서 중부·남서부에 걸쳐 번식하고 중국 남서부와 인도차이나 북부에서 겨울을 난다.
young: 첫해 어린새는 아랫면이 담황색이나 노르스름한 담황색을 띠고, 멱과 가슴의 가는 노란 세로줄이 거의 보이지 않는다.

art.subject: Yellow-streaked Warbler (Phylloscopus amandii, correctly Phylloscopus armandii), adult, as seen in Korea on spring migration: upperparts plain olive-brown; long pale buffish-white supercilium; dark brown eye-stripe; mottled ear-coverts; underparts dull whitish with fine, faint yellowish streaks on the throat and breast, buff-brown flanks and buffish undertail coverts; wings and tail plain brown without wing-bars. Bill fairly short and pointed, dark above and pale below; dark eye; legs pale yellowish-brown.
art.pose: hopping through dense low undergrowth, side view
art.scene: dense undergrowth at a woodland edge on a Korean offshore island during spring migration; no people, buildings or text
art.build: Small, rather stocky leaf warbler, smaller than a sparrow and bigger-headed than Dusky Warbler. Bill fairly short, slender and pointed (finer than Radde's Warbler's), shorter than the head. Legs fairly long and sturdy, pale. Short rounded wings with a short primary projection; tail medium length, square-ended. Skulks low in thick cover and on the ground.
avoid: Do not paint green upperparts or bright yellow underparts; the bird is olive-brown with only faint yellowish streaks below.
Do not add wing-bars or a crown stripe.
Do not paint a thick, stubby bill (Radde's Warbler, Phylloscopus schwarzi) or dark legs.
